## Scope consequences and quarantine

| Recovered issue | Scientific question permitted into the brief | Material retained only here and in linked evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A measured map and a selected projected model have different roles | What quantity does the model represent, and what compatibility makes removal/rejoin meaningful? | Historical selectors, thresholds, interpolation choices and outcomes |
| The realized residual processing and restoration can involve changed state/support | Which state is fixed, and under what assumptions do response or cancellation identities hold? | Actual code order, flag/weight actions and measured differences |
| Past checkpoint inventories and empirical equality tests cover particular realizations | What information is causally sufficient for exact continuation? | Schemas, stored field lists and test outcomes |
| Multiple trajectory metrics and outcomes can disagree | What distinct claims follow from completion, convergence and terminal selection? | Numerical stopping proposals, exposed populations and metric values |

These rows generate questions, not scientific answers. The author does not
receive this table, its linked sources or historical outcomes. The exact
public questions are in the sanitized Scope Brief. This explicit dossier
and the linked recovery record replace the r0.1 packet's implicit reliance
